item.title: Buffalo Public Schools releases results of investigation after claims of cover-ups, obstruction
item.description: Buffalo Public Schools released the results of an independent investigation after Buffalo police detective Richard Hy accused the district of cover-ups and obstructing investigations.

item.title: Metal Craft to establish first U.S. plant in Niagara Falls
item.description: A Canadian metal manufacturing company is planning to establish its first U.S. production facility in Niagara Falls, bringing new investment and jobs to Western New York.

item.title: Internal Email: Candlelight Cabinetry delays return from employee furlough
item.description: 7 News has received multiple copies of an internal Candlelight Cabinetry email that says, “key conversations have taken longer than hoped and delayed our plans… Furlough will be continued.”

item.title: Former Canal Fest treasurer charged with stealing $11,000 from festival
item.description: The former treasurer of Canal Fest of the Tonawandas has been charged with grand larceny for allegedly stealing more than $11,000 from the nonprofit organization that puts on the annual festival.
